name: Meltwater
description: Meltwater is a media-intelligence platform for monitoring editorial and social sources, organizing saved searches, and analyzing coverage and conversations. Its API products expose listening, analytics, Explore+, content ingestion, integrations, and AI-assisted insight workflows for eligible customer accounts.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-generated Meltwater API token, then let agents inspect redacted API-usage status and bounded saved-search references for the token's default company.

credentialRequirements.name: MELTWATER_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Meltwater API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated token under Account > Meltwater API. Relay encrypts it and sends it only in the apikey header to https://api.meltwater.com.

capabilities.label: Read API usage and search structure
capabilities.description: Read a redacted 24-hour API-usage summary and at most twenty-five saved-search ID/update references for the token's default company.

approvalRequired.label: Get Meltwater API usage
approvalRequired.description: Read only total request count, time unit, and time-series point count for the last twenty-four hours, excluding token IDs and endpoint-level call details.

approvalRequired.label: List Meltwater search references
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five saved-search IDs and update timestamps without names, queries, keywords, filter sets, content, or analytics.

blocked.label: Access identity or search configuration
blocked.description: Companies, workspaces, users, token IDs, names, descriptions, queries, keywords, filters, folders, tags, categories, sources, and configuration are blocked.

blocked.label: Access content or analytics
blocked.description: Mentions, articles, posts, messages, URLs, media, authors, profiles, metrics, sentiment, reports, dashboards, endpoint-level usage, exports, and Mira responses remain blocked.

blocked.label: Write, import, or administer Meltwater
blocked.description: Creating, updating, or deleting searches, filters, exports, streams, hooks, imports, tags, content, tokens, users, integrations, or administration remains blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API, streams, or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, methods, queries, bodies, company overrides, pagination, polling, streaming, MCP, bulk operations, browser sessions, and undocumented endpoints remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both bounded reads require approval; identity, search configuration, content, analytics, writes, imports, streams, raw APIs, pagination, bulk, and export remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same two bounded reads run directly; fixed GET routes, default-company authority, redaction, response caps, audits, and provider rate responses remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives two bounded Meltwater reads with token-default-company authority and identity/content redaction.
Hermes receives the same two bounded Meltwater reads with token-default-company authority and identity/content redaction.

providerSetup.blocker: Meltwater API access and limits depend on the customer's package and contract; a user with Admin-level Meltwater API permission must create the token.
providerSetup.nextAction: An eligible customer administrator creates a dedicated Meltwater API token and completes a live read-only connection check.

evidence.supports: Meltwater documents the fixed https://api.meltwater.com origin, API-token authentication through the apikey header, HTTPS-only requests, provider error codes, and HTTP 429 rate responses.
Official guidance says an Admin-level Meltwater API user creates and revokes tokens under Account > Meltwater API and the secret is displayed only once.
Official reference documents GET /v3/usage/me/requests, the fixed 24hours period, and count, units, and time_series response fields.
Official reference documents GET /v3/searches; Relay returns only at most twenty-five safe IDs and update timestamps and never includes saved-search names or queries.
Meltwater documents contract-dependent quotas, general API limits of 100 calls per minute, a platform-wide 2,000 requests per hour per IP limit, and rate-limit response headers.

securityNotes: The customer token is encrypted as a secret reference; it is sent only in the apikey header to https://api.meltwater.com and never in URLs, prompts, logs, catalog records, or results.
Relay allowlists only GET /v3/usage/me/requests?period=24hours and GET /v3/searches and never supplies company_id, token_id, include_query, or other caller-controlled parameters.

Every request rejects redirects, caps responses at 1 MB, returns at most twenty-five saved-search references, and never follows pagination or starts exports, streams, analytics, search, imports, or Mira calls.
Search names, queries, keywords, filters, companies, workspaces, users, endpoint-level usage, content, authors, URLs, media, analytics, reports, writes, and administration are excluded.
Relay preserves provider HTTP 429 responses and does not promise a quota beyond Meltwater's contract-dependent package limits and published general platform limits.
